title: System analysis
body:
[[Software Requirements Analysis]]
[[Modeling]]

Understanding the whole system before changing it: what exists now, who uses it, where it
sits in the organisation, and what the boundary is between the software and everything around
it. [[Software Requirements Analysis]] is the part that produces the written requirements;
system analysis is the wider activity it lives inside, including the parts that are not
software at all (the manual process being replaced, the people whose jobs change, the systems
that will have to keep talking to it).

The boundary question is the one that carries forward. Deciding what is inside the system and
what is an external actor is done here, in [[Problem Recognition]], and it is exactly what
[[Use Case Diagrams]] draw.
